description.narrative: The project seeks to enhance the capacity of youth, women, and people with disabilities living in informal settlements on digital literacy and safety, and to enable civic education and awareness raising on Technology-Facilitated Gender Based Violence (TFGBV) through digital civic spaces. A growing area of concern in Kenya, TFGBV has far-reaching impacts on the rights, safety, and participation of individuals in digital and offline spaces, particularly women and girls. The 2022 General Elections in Kenya saw a dramatic increase in GBV (including TFGBV), and as the 2027 General Elections in Kenya approach, this project is timely and needed to support inclusive online civic engagement and to support the prevention of TFGBV amongst marginalised communities.Targeting informal settlements in Nairobi, Kiambu, Machakos, and Kajiado counties, this project will directly support communities most at risk and vulnerable to digital abuse in the lead up to the 2027 Elections, and learnings from this project can be shared with the Embassy’s other partners working on youth and women civic engagement.
